text:
By Ace Sauerwein ,
8 hours ago
Repent your sins, you sinners.
The financial website WalletHub conducted a study to call out the most sinful states in America.
"Some states are more well-behaved than others, though. In order to determine the states that most give in to their desires, WalletHub compared the 50 states across 54 key indicators of immoral or illicit behavior. Our data set ranges from violent crimes per capita to excessive drinking to the share of the population with gambling disorders. -WalletHub" Montana Ranks 30th in Most Sinful States We landed just below the halfway mark among the 50 states. Montana‚Äôs total Vice Idex Score was 36.53 . Our most sinful ranking was in the ‚ÄúGreed‚Äù category. Montana was the 5th greediest state in the country.
Our lowest ranking was the ‚ÄúVanity‚Äù category, where we were 44th. Here‚Äôs our full rankings:
Anger & Hatred (11th) Jealousy (38th) Excesses & Vices (10th) Greed (5th) Lust (39th) Vanity (44th) READ MORE: What to do in Missoula This March
No surprise that the most sinful state was Nevada (60.98 Vice index score). I mean, they‚Äôre the home of Sin City, so I would hope so. California, Louisiana, Florida, and Texas round out the top 5.
The least sinful state is Wyoming (24.49 Vice index score), followed by New Hampshire, Idaho, Vermont, and Maine.
It‚Äôs interesting that two of our neighbors were in the bottom five, while Montana was closer to the middle. What‚Äôs the difference once you cross the state lines?
